source.stem: What helps oxygen to be absorbed rapidly into the blood in the lungs?

options.text: Air breathed in has less oxygen than air breathed out.
Alveoli have thick walls and a large surface area.
Alveoli have thin walls and a large surface area.
The concentration of oxygen in the blood is higher than in the alveoli.

intelligence.enrichment: Organisms compete for common resources such as food, water, physical space, and sunlight; this competition helps control population size and keep the ecosystem balanced. When organisms need the same limited resources, competition restricts their population growth and resource use. The learner correctly applies this rule: Organisms compete for common resources such as food, water, physical space, and sunlight; this competition helps control population size and keep the ecosystem balanced. Competition is only fighting for food between animals and always harms ecosystem balance.
